meaning:
προ-οράω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Psa.16:8) (שָׁוָה pi.), I Est.5:63 A * ;]
to see before (as to place or time): with accusative, Act.21:29. Mid., with accusative, before ἐνώπιόν μου, Act.2:25 (LXX).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.
